tools.name: clips_generate
tools.description: Paste-a-link clipping (clips.generate): ranks the moments viewers actually care about (YouTube most-replayed, timestamped comments, live-chat spikes, viewer-made Twitch clips, Shorts re-cuts, AI hook/payoff, audio, motion), cuts 15-60 s 9:16 captioned clips on sentence boundaries. Optional originali

tools.name: clips_status
tools.description: Status of a clips_generate job; when done, the ranked clips with virality score (0-100), per-signal breakdown and reasons.

tools.name: generate_script
tools.description: Generate a real video script (or, with style=ai_video_prompt, a structured Syllaby-schema AI-video-generation prompt) via the SAME Claude call /api/v1/scripts/generate uses -- no mock text.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Exact live prices (USD) for MakeMyContent plans and MakeMyContent Clips, with checkout lookup keys. Read-only, no key needed.

tools.name: sounds_like_you
tools.description: Score how human a caption or short post sounds (0-100 plus plain-English suggestions). Deterministic, read-only, no key needed.

tools.name: viral_ideas
tools.description: F4929's honest trend x format idea finder: real cached Google Trends relative-index rising queries x this fleet's actual content formats. Never a trained virality classifier, never padded with invented ideas -- returns fewer than n if fewer real trend/format combinations exist, and an honest no_redi

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sounds_like_you · Public sink: sounds_like_you · Destructive: viral_ideas.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sounds_like_you · Public sink: sounds_like_you · Destructive: viral_ideas

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
